arms.rbf_kernel: Isotropic Gaussian kernel ridge, widths 0.2/0.5/1/2 and penalties 0.01/0.1/1, selected by leave-one-out squared error on public observations only; centered outputs and nonnegative forecasts
arms.gaussian_three_source: Three positive Gaussian bumps centered at high-response observed coordinates selected with a 0.3 distance exclusion; widths 0.3/0.6/1.2 selected by leave-one-out squared error; nonnegative least-squares weights and background
arms.privileged_inverse_quadratic: Explicit upstream response form b+sum alpha/(m+distance²), with b=0.1, alpha=1, m=0.0001 and three sources supplied as a clearly privileged equation-specific ceiling; six unknown source coordinates fitted from public data using five fixed multistarts, no private locations

primary_metric: Heldout mean absolute error across 32 responses; report RMSE and median absolute error separately
purpose: Three reused development worlds only. Compare generic numerical fits with an explicitly privileged structural ceiling before evaluating any semantic proposer. No model-performance confirmation or active design claim.
forbidden: No private response or true source location in fitter, no Azure or other closed-source model API
